vo.l01: Tonight... the midnight snack war. Winner gets the last slice.
vo.l02: In the red corner... the fridge! Two hundred kilos of cold steel. It hums all night, it hides your leftovers behind the pickles, and it has never once said sorry.
vo.l03: And in the blue corner... the human! Opens the fridge forty times a day, stares for ten seconds, and still finds nothing to eat.
vo.l04: Fun fact: that fridge light only works when you're watching. Nobody knows what it does in the dark.
vo.l05: Ohh! Freezer burn! That one left ice cubes on his eyebrows!
vo.l06: But humans have something fridges never had... a three a.m. appetite.
vo.l08: Down goes the fridge! Big appliance down!
vo.l11: The fridge is out cold... which, honestly, is exactly how it likes it. And the leftovers? Gone before the bell.
vo.l12: Let's see that again... watch that uppercut. The door swings open, and the light finally goes out.

caption: Man vs. fridge 🥊🧊 Who wins the midnight snack war? 👇
